msg: There are two important features.Important feature 1.Gnomes are paired in the following colors (in any order):- orange & brown- green & pink- red & yellow- blue & purpleImportant Feature 2.Gnomes of a certain color will lead you to one of two types of forests. Each of the gnomes' colors lead to the following:Light Forest:- orange- green- red- blueDark Forest:- Brown- Pink- Yellow PurpleYOUR ULTIMATE GOAL: Find out which forest nets you the most mushrooms.Please note: It is irrelevant which size, shape, position, or any other characteristic other than the fact that they are colored. Please only pay attention to the color. The amount of mushrooms will vary. However, you will notice a pattern that the forest with the most mushrooms are usually > 4. If you notice that the forest is decreasing in mushrooms, it's possible that you need to change forests since it alternates, although this isn't always the case.It can often help to write it down and group the colors together according to which forest they will direct you to.The best of luck to you.
